{{Quote|Internal Affairs calls their field agents "keyns," after a renown ''[sic]'' tracking carnivore of the Gontzol system, ''[&hellip;]''.|An Imperial Intelligence report|<ref name="ISB2" />}}
The '''Gontzol system''' was located within the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[keyn]]s.<ref name="ISB2" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] mentioned the Gontzol [[Star system/Legends|system]] in a report prepared for an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]], which in turn was added by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] to a compilation of Imperial documents for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="ISB2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gontzol system was first mentioned in the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Greg Gorden]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] roleplaying game source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]], placed the system in the [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gontzol system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
